import cyclopts

def main(
    name: str = "World",
    greeting: str = "Hello",
    count: int = 1,
    verbose: bool = False,
):
    """Simple greeter with TOML config support.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    name : str, optional
        Person to greet, by default "World"
    greeting : str, optional
        Greeting word, by default "Hello"
    count : int, optional
        Number of times to greet, by default 1
    verbose : bool, optional
        Show verbose output, by default False
    """
    for _ in range(count):
        print(f"{greeting}, {name}!")
    if verbose:
        print(f"Greeted {name} {count} time(s)")

app = cyclopts.App(
    config_search_paths=["pyproject.toml"],
    config_name="tool.mycli",
)
app.default = main

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
